content_of_post_to_comment:
When I started this six days ago I was hoping to weave into a community here. As a reddit rookie I didn't have many expectations though, only that I would show up.

I observed that this is another platform people consume, many passively. I understand that the sheer quantity of posts and options make it hard to stay present, there's even badges for scrolling length. So my journey is just one grain of sand on the beach, and that's okay! And I am grateful for all the 5, 6 souls who shared thoughts with me.

With that being said I believe that continuing the full two weeks on this platform does not support the purpose. So I'll finish off the week tomorrow and then move on to where I can create that value.

Best hack of today: act on a RL activity within 5min of thinking of it. After that, willpower loses against a screen

Worst thought of today: Looking up someones summer activities equals relaxing
